name: SG1120-1202 group 1 (Hubble)
blurb: Group 1 of the supergroup SG1120-1202, a gathering of galaxy groups, seen by Hubble.
label: sg112012021-hubble
story: One of four galaxy groups that are falling together and will merge into a cluster comparable in mass to the Coma Cluster. Hubble looked here for every star in and between the group's galaxies, including the faint light drifting in the space between them.

claims.text: SG1120-1202 is a supergroup made of four X-ray luminous galaxy groups that will merge into a cluster comparable in mass to Coma
Group 1 lies at RA 11:20:07.48, Dec -12:05:09.1, matching the HST pointing SG1120-1 (11 20 07.517, -12 05 09.40)
HST program 12575 pointing SG1120-1 aims at a complete census of stars in and out of group galaxies (intragroup light)
